description: Fixed per-condition target captions used for CLIPout. Identical for all methods.

captions.rainy: a rainy scene with rain falling, dark storm clouds, wet surfaces, and puddles
captions.snowy: a snowy scene with heavy snowfall, snow accumulation, and a cold winter atmosphere
captions.foggy: a foggy scene with dense fog, low visibility, and a misty hazy atmosphere
captions.night: a nighttime scene with darkness, artificial lights, and deep shadows
captions.clear: a clear sunny day with a bright blue sky, sunlight, and high visibility
